changelog:
HERITAGE 2
. Notification scenes: built-in, URL, local scenes together. Preview, copy, edit. Title, message, color, animation, sound configurable. Larger icon library, search, lazy load. Banner placement top/center/bottom, long message expands on tap. Soft color wash, optional HA mark. Trigger via HA Notification Scene entity. Thanks @matkastner #173. Path: Settings → Interaction → Displays & Scenes → Notification Scenes.

Camera on screensaver: motion detection shows camera, close returns to dashboard. Screensaver timeout can be 0 for always-visible dashboard. Two-way switch syncs with HA. Thanks @matkastner #174.

Per-device calibration: sync delay and 5-band EQ tune each Ava separately through local communication. Music console lists adjustable players. Lyric offset ±500ms, 5 follow levels from Steady to Tight. Tap lyrics for fine adjustment.

Music overlay: waiting state before song arrives, auto-close if no media. Natural cover transition, loaded playlist covers cached. Hidden lyrics stop refreshing when collapsed. Network recovery respects user shape. Portrait right edge handle reduces accidental console open. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media & Playback.

Expressions: orb shows happy eyes, warnings, apologies. Changes during long replies, evaluated on device.

Update page: release cover, full notes, portrait top-to-bottom, landscape columns. Recent versions selectable. Cover cache limited to 3. Update vs Reinstall clearer. Firmware 2026.09.1.

30 fixes: TTS replies (5), interface (5), memory leaks (10), reliability (10). Echo cancellation preserves speech naturally. MA queue failure keeps current state. Sendspin hardened. Dashboard retries only on genuine failure. Duplicate install blocked.
